row.rowText: Total Stock Change Of Energy Products

row.footnote: Petroleum Products include Ethane, LPG, Aviation Gasoline, Motor Gasoline, Jet Fuel, Kerosene, Gas/Diesel Oil, Fuel Oil, Naphtha, White Spirit, Lubricants, Bitumen, Paraffin Waxes, Petroleum Coke and other Petroleum Products.  The corresponding HS 2022 codes for the energy products mentioned are available in https://www.ema.gov.sg/resources/singapore-energy-statistics/technical-notes-glossary

Natural Gas includes Natural Gas (excluding Natural Gas Liquids) and Town Gas.  The corresponding HS 2022 codes for the energy products mentioned are available in https://www.ema.gov.sg/resources/singapore-energy-statistics/technical-notes-glossary
